authority.note: A completed batch command is not a transcription anyone should trust. Raw output is a candidate; the .omr project is the evidence object and MusicXML is a lossy projection of it.

blocked_on.note: the toolchain is ready; the input is not here yet

cli_contract_confirmed.note: verified from the installed binary's own -help output, not from docs

ocr.note: no OCR language data ships with the installer. English is installed before the reviewed pass; text recognition stays auxiliary evidence, because noteheads, stems, beams, durations, voices and navigation are not text.

purpose: bind the optical music recognition toolchain by identity before it transcribes anything, so a later transcription can name the exact binary that produced it

tool.console_variant: chosen so launch and processing diagnostics are visible; the silent-install path was avoided because it bypasses directory selection and weakens versioned custody
tool.distribution: official GitHub release, Windows Console MSI
tool.name: Audiveris
tool.provenance_warning_observed: downloaded only from the Audiveris/audiveris GitHub organisation; the similarly named .com site is unrelated
